daily.brief: 過去約30小時（15日凌晨到16日上午）有737則帖、197個帳號。最熱鬧的是$NVDA，246則帖裡看淡帳號略多（22對19），有人談黃仁勳回歸時機完美。最乾淨的多頭是MU、NBIS、AVGO，各有3-4個帳號一致看好，MU還有人設目標價780-800。BA和LMT則因火箭失敗被3個帳號明確看淡。
daily.full:
共識

MU有4個帳號一致看好，19則帖。@EliteOptions2分享交易想法，買11月20日780C在734，目標780、800，止損700。原帖。@WheelieInvestor賣出$775 put，只要保持在775以上就賺權利金。原帖。@JonahLupton提到DRAM價格Q4可能再升12-15%，明年20-30%，好奇運營利潤率能否到84-85%。原帖。

NBIS有3個帳號看好，16則帖。@daniel_koss為它辯護，區分論點被證明錯誤的持倉，與論點正在實現但價格下跌（因糟糕宏觀、Jensen恐慌及僅一季失望）的情況，認為關鍵指標發展極佳。原帖。@ACInvestorBlog看到MACD正面背離，與先前見底模式一致，一直在累積股份。原帖。@BlackPantherCap不相信會看到破產那種情況。原帖。

AVGO有3個帳號看好，9則帖。@damnang2和@jukan05對郭明錤估計的谷歌TPU大規模出貨（OpenAI約12M台、Anthropic約14M台，2028-29年）作出正面反應，稱數字Holy smoke。原帖 原帖。

PANW、HD、LOW、TGT、LLY、APP、MELI各有2個帳號看好。@philrosenn指Eli Lilly複利穩定，可能成為標普500最大股票，肥胖藥物仍早期。原帖。

共同看淡

BA和LMT各有3個帳號明確看淡，都因波音-洛克希德發射載具中途失敗，損失亞馬遜衛星載荷。@FirstSquawk、原帖 @LiveSquawk、原帖 @wallstengine都報道這件事。原帖。

SMMT有2個帳號看淡。@JacobPlieth指CRL震驚，在沒有OS益處的情況下有效性的實質證據未確立。原帖。@adamfeuerstein提到FDA溝通和披露時間。原帖。

分歧

NVDA是絕對主角，246則帖，看好19個帳號、看淡22個。@DanielTNiles說如果已看到頂部，賺錢將困難得多，但NVDA將幸存，許多新雲則不會。原帖。@wliang稱Jensen Huang和NVDA是一體的，他潛在回歸的時機完美無缺。原帖。@Jake__Wujastyk對J-Dog回歸有相當信心。原帖。看淡聲音仍略多。

SPCX偏多但有交鋒，21個看好對1個看淡，70則帖。@itschrisray指出外面真的只有SPCX和RKLB。原帖。@elonmusk說Starlink幫助農村學校進行教育。原帖。@SawyerMerritt提到三星將在德克薩斯州為SpaceX製造衛星芯片。原帖。

QQQ有6對4，26則帖；SPY有6對2，31則帖。期貨反彈被提及，但有人看put wall。

其他值得留意

GOOGL有4對1，18則帖，TPU出貨估計被正面看待。AMD有4對1。整體AI相關鏈和太空名字有多頭，但大票分歧明顯，零售股如HD、LOW、TGT也有共識看好。
daily.html:
短摘要

weekly.brief: 過去7日（11月10日至16日）有2132則帖、264個帳號。AMAT持續是最明確的共識看好，9個帳號沒有看淡。RKLB、SNDK、NU、PANW也有支持。NVDA仍是最大熱點但意見分裂，看淡較多（35對31），852則帖。MSTR、IWM、BA是較清楚的看淡名字。
weekly.full:
共識

AMAT在這週持續獲看好，9個帳號明確支持，零看淡。@BarbarianCap提到因半導體需求銷售和利潤上升。原帖。@tenet_research指出CEO提到創紀錄的FY26業績，預計半導體系統在2026日曆年增長超過40%。原帖。RKLB有5個、SNDK有4個、NU有4個、PANW有4個帳號站在多頭。整體AI相關芯片和太空名字有較強共識。

共同看淡

MSTR有4個帳號明確看淡。IWM、BA各有4個。部分指數和商品有較一致的負面看法。

分歧

NVDA依舊最大分歧，31個看好對35個看淡，852則帖。SPCX偏多30對6，145則帖。AMD有15對1，73則帖。SPY有10對5，97則帖。有人認為AI資本支出故事未變；有人擔心短期事件和估值。

其他值得留意

整體AI和太空主題延續，但短期情緒被個別公司新聞干擾，如火箭失敗影響BA和LMT。
weekly.html:

monthly.brief: 過去28日（10月20日至11月16日）有6414則帖、302個帳號，討論量最大。SOFI、AMAT各有9個帳號共識看好，LLY有8個。RDDT有多個帳號看淡。大市NVDA、SPCX、SPY意見分裂嚴重。AI主題仍是主軸，但個別公司事件和估值分歧明顯。

其他值得留意

市場輪動和個股事件影響較大，28日數據顯示共識和分歧同時存在，太空和AI鏈名字持續有關注。

NVDA 246則帖中看淡帳號略多（22對19），有人談黃仁勳回歸時機。SPCX獲21個帳號共識看好，Starlink和芯片製造被點名。MU有4個帳號共識看好，@EliteOptions2設目標780-800，止損700。

daily.brief: Over the past ~30 hours (early morning of the 15th to morning of the 16th) there were 737 posts from 197 accounts. The busiest was $NVDA, with 246 posts where bearish accounts slightly outnumber bullish ones (22 vs 19), with talk of Jensen Huang’s return timing being perfect. The cleanest longs are MU, NBIS, and AVGO, each with 3-4 accounts in agreement; MU also has targets of 780-800. BA and LMT were clearly bearish from 3 accounts due to a rocket failure.
daily.full:
Consensus

MU has 4 accounts in agreement, 19 posts. @EliteOptions2 shares trade ideas, buying Nov 20 780C at 734, target 780 and 800, stop 700. original post. @WheelieInvestor sold $775 puts, keeping the premium if it stays above 775. original post. @JonahLupton notes DRAM prices may rise another 12-15% in Q4, 20-30% next year, wondering if operating margins can reach 84-85%. original post.

NBIS has 3 bullish accounts, 16 posts. @daniel_koss defends it, distinguishing positions where the thesis was proven wrong from cases where the thesis is playing out but the price is down (due to bad macro, Jensen panic, and only one disappointing quarter), saying key metrics are developing extremely well. original post. @ACInvestorBlog sees positive divergence on MACD, consistent with prior bottoming patterns, and has been accumulating shares. original post. @BlackPantherCap does not believe we will see bankruptcy scenarios. original post.

AVGO has 3 bullish accounts, 9 posts. @damnang2 and @jukan05 reacted positively to Ming-Chi Kuo’s estimate of massive Google TPU shipments (OpenAI ~12M units, Anthropic ~14M units in 2028-29), calling the numbers Holy smoke. original post original post.

PANW, HD, LOW, TGT, LLY, APP, MELI each have 2 bullish accounts. @philrosenn notes Eli Lilly’s compounding is so steady it may become the largest stock in the S&P 500, with obesity drugs still early. original post.

Joint Bearish

BA and LMT each have 3 accounts clearly bearish, all due to the Boeing-Lockheed launch vehicle failing mid-flight and losing Amazon satellite payload. @FirstSquawk, original post @LiveSquawk, original post @wallstengine all reported it. original post.

SMMT has 2 bearish accounts. @JacobPlieth says the CRL is shocking: substantial evidence of effectiveness not established without OS benefit. original post. @adamfeuerstein mentions FDA communication and disclosure timing. original post.

Divergence

NVDA is the absolute protagonist with 246 posts, 19 bullish and 22 bearish accounts. @DanielTNiles says if we have seen the top, making money will be much harder, but NVDA will survive while many new clouds will not. original post. @wliang calls Jensen Huang and NVDA one and the same, with the timing of his potential return perfect. original post. @Jake__Wujastyk has considerable confidence in the J-Dog return. original post. Bearish voices are still slightly more numerous.

SPCX leans bullish with some back-and-forth, 21 vs 1, 70 posts. @itschrisray points out there are really only SPCX and RKLB out there. original post. @elonmusk says Starlink helps rural schools with education. original post. @SawyerMerritt notes Samsung will manufacture satellite chips for SpaceX in Texas. original post.

QQQ has 6 vs 4, 26 posts; SPY has 6 vs 2, 31 posts. Futures rebound is mentioned, but some watch put walls.

Other Noteworthy

GOOGL has 4 vs 1, 18 posts, with TPU shipment estimates viewed positively. AMD has 4 vs 1. Overall AI-related chains and space names have longs, but large names show clear divergence; retail names like HD, LOW, TGT also have consensus bullish.

NVDA 246 posts with slightly more bearish than bullish accounts (22 vs 19), with talk of Jensen Huang’s return. MU has 4 accounts in consensus bullish with targets 780-800; BA/LMT bearish on rocket failure. 737 posts from 197 accounts.

weekly.brief: Over the past 7 days (Nov 10 to 16) there were 2132 posts from 264 accounts. AMAT remains the clearest consensus bullish with 9 accounts and zero bearish. RKLB, SNDK, NU, PANW also have support. NVDA is still the biggest hotspot but split, with more bearish (35 vs 31), 852 posts. MSTR, IWM, BA are clearer bearish names.
weekly.full:
Consensus

AMAT continued to be favored this week, 9 accounts clearly supportive with zero bearish. @BarbarianCap notes sales and profits rising due to semiconductor demand. original post. @tenet_research points out the CEO mentioned record FY26 results, expecting semiconductor systems to grow over 40% in calendar 2026. original post. RKLB has 5, SNDK 4, NU 4, PANW 4 accounts on the long side. Overall AI-related chips and space names have stronger consensus.

Joint Bearish

MSTR has 4 accounts clearly bearish. IWM and BA each have 4. Some indices and commodities have more consistent negative views.

Divergence

NVDA remains the biggest split, 31 bullish vs 35 bearish, 852 posts. SPCX leans bullish 30 vs 6, 145 posts. AMD has 15 vs 1, 73 posts. SPY has 10 vs 5, 97 posts. Some see the AI capex story unchanged; others worry about near-term events and valuation.

Other Noteworthy

The AI and space themes continue, but near-term sentiment is interrupted by individual company news, such as the rocket failure affecting BA and LMT.

Today's Highlights

NVDA 246 posts with slightly more bearish accounts (22 vs 19), with talk of Jensen Huang’s return timing. SPCX receives consensus from 21 accounts bullish, with Starlink and chip manufacturing noted. MU has 4 accounts in consensus bullish; @EliteOptions2 sets targets 780-800, stop 700.
